verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI's own docs offer agent-oriented documentation: a downloadable skill package that gives AI coding assistants complete Crawl4AI knowledge. However, the probe found no llms.txt (HTTP 404 at docs.crawl4ai.com/llms.txt), so the story is only partly delivered. Missing for 10: a published llms.txt, detail on the skill package's contents and format, and independent hands-on corroboration of agents consuming it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Supercharge your AI coding assistant with complete Crawl4AI knowledge! Download our comprehensive skill package
